title: Bufalin targeting METTL17 inhibits the occurrence and metastasis of oral cancer through JAK1/STAT3 signaling pathway.
authors: Zhang, Huhu; Sun, Fulin; Ding, Xiaoyan; Dong, Xiaolei; Yang, Fanghao; Chen, Ruolan; Zhang, Xiaoze; Wen, Ziyuan; Su, Mohan; Yu, Chunjuan; Wang, Yiming; Yang, Lina; Li, Bing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物bufalin靶向METTL17蛋白抑制口腔癌，虽用分子对接预测结合位点，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦TF-DNA体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Oral cancer (OC) is a malignant tumor that arises at the mucosal tissues of the oral cavity and is commonly treated with surgical resection. Bufalin is one of the most potent anticancer monomers extracted from bufonis venenum and has been shown to have anticancer effects against a wide range of cancers, including lung cancer, gastric cancer and hepatocellular carcinomas. However, there are fewer studies on the role of bufalin in OC and a lack of clear targets. Moreover, bufalin is more difficult to apply clinically due to its cardiac glycoside effects. Notably, oral cancer is a facial tumor, and bufalin acts first in the oral tissues and does not need to go through the blood circulation to reach the heart, which greatly mitigates the risk and overcomes the major limitation. The effects of bufalin on the proliferation and migration of oral cancer cells were detected by CCK-8 assay, wound healing assay, transwell assay and Western blot. Potential direct interacting proteins of bufalin were screened by human proteomic microarray, and the binding sites were predicted using molecular docking technology. In vitro and vivo biological experiments were performed to verify the role of bufalin direct interacting protein and the mechanism by which bufalin targets this protein to inhibit OC metastasis. The results showed that bufalin inhibited the proliferation and migration of OC cell lines from Cal-27, HN30 and SCC-15 cultured in vitro. METTL17, a direct-interacting protein of bufalin, has several potential binding sites with bufalin. METTL17 is highly expressed in OC and promotes OC occurrence and development in vitro and vivo through activation of the JAK1/STAT3 signaling pathway. Bufalin reversed the promotional effect of METTL17 on OC by down-regulating METTL17 expression. These results provide a new rationale for bufalin as a promising drug for the treatment of OC and avoid the difficulty that bufalin has a strong cardiac glycosides effect on the heart through the bloodstream.
abstract_zh: 口腔癌（OC）是一种发生于口腔黏膜组织的恶性肿瘤，通常通过手术切除进行治疗。蟾毒灵（bufalin）是从蟾酥中提取的最有效的抗癌单体之一，已被证明对多种癌症具有抗癌作用，包括肺癌、胃癌和肝细胞癌。然而，关于蟾毒灵在口腔癌中作用的研究较少，且缺乏明确的作用靶点。此外，由于蟾毒灵具有强心苷效应，其在临床应用中较为困难。值得注意的是，口腔癌是一种面部肿瘤，蟾毒灵首先作用于口腔组织，无需通过血液循环到达心脏，这大大降低了风险并克服了这一主要限制。通过CCK-8实验、伤口愈合实验、Transwell实验和Western blot检测了蟾毒灵对口腔癌细胞增殖和迁移的影响。通过人类蛋白质组微阵列筛选了蟾毒灵的潜在直接相互作用蛋白，并利用分子对接技术预测了结合位点。进行了体外和体内生物学实验，以验证蟾毒灵直接相互作用蛋白的作用以及蟾毒灵靶向该蛋白抑制口腔癌转移的机制。结果表明，蟾毒灵抑制了体外培养的Cal-27、HN30和SCC-15口腔癌细胞系的增殖和迁移。METTL17作为蟾毒灵的直接相互作用蛋白，与蟾毒灵具有多个潜在结合位点。METTL17在口腔癌中高表达，并通过激活JAK1/STAT3信号通路在体外和体内促进口腔癌的发生和发展。蟾毒灵通过下调METTL17表达逆转了METTL17对口腔癌的促进作用。这些结果为蟾毒灵作为治疗口腔癌的有前景药物提供了新的依据，并避免了蟾毒灵通过血流对心脏产生强心苷效应的困难。
